_comment: Declarative spec for the Cloudflare R2 bucket used by GULA. Apply via `wrangler r2 bucket create` + `wrangler r2 bucket cors put`. Bucket stores signed PDF lab reports only — never PHI beyond what's rendered on the report itself (same trust boundary as email/SMS PDF attachments).

lifecycle.description: Lab reports expire 90 days after the signed link is issued (matches RESULT_LINK_EXPIRE_DAYS).
Abort multipart uploads that did not finish within 1 day.

notes: Objects are served only through signed URLs issued by the backend; bucket-public-access must remain disabled.
Encryption at rest is applied by R2 by default (AES-256).
Access keys must be created with the 'Object Read & Write' scope limited to this bucket only — never account-wide.
